title: Archive and Orbit
author: H. M. Zhou
blurb: Ada Almeida, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
